model: HN Series humidity / temperature transmitter (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Greystone HN series humidity and temperature transmitters with BACnet MS/TP and an optional relay.
summary: The HN is a Greystone RH and temperature transmitter with native BACnet MS/TP. RH and temperature are two Analog Inputs; offsets and the optional relay setpoint, hysteresis and delay are Analog Values, and Binary Values set units, relay test and which reading drives the relay.
notes: Points from the object table on page 1 of the setup guide.
The relay objects report a fault when no relay is fitted. AV 3 and AV 4 are in %RH or degrees depending on BV 3.
Object names are as printed, including the spelling "Relay Hysterisis".
Access from the PICS: AV and BV Present_Value are writable.

source.title: HN Series Humidity/Temperature Transmitter - Setup Guide for BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC in the menu, then read RH (AI 1) and temperature (AI 2). The relay settings only matter when the relay option drives local equipment.
setup: Device instance defaults to 381001 (381000 + MAC 1); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
gotchas: Set BV 3 (relay assignment) before AV 3/AV 4; their units and ranges follow it.
